## Scope

What changes and which user need does this address?

## Evidence

Link research, source documentation, or rationale. Mark assumptions that remain unvalidated.

## Data and licensing

- [ ] Data provenance and terms documented; reuse is permitted where applicable.
- [ ] No restricted market data or full article text added.

## Security and privacy

- [ ] No credentials, personal financial data, or private customer information added.
- [ ] Security/privacy implications reviewed.

## Simulation boundary

- [ ] No live broker connection, order placement, buy/sell signals, profit promises, or unsupported compliance claims.
- [ ] Historical/synthetic results and assumptions are clearly labeled.

## Verification

- [ ] Relevant checks or manual review steps described.
- [ ] Known limitations and follow-up work documented.
